rule: Distinguish requirements for establishing the synthesis theory from requirements for a new general law or new morphology.

synthesis_theory.question: Are the definitions and axioms internally coherent and non-circular?
bugs_closed: history-only state omitted hidden machine configuration
legal development could smuggle human engineering
scalar verifier threshold did not cover heterogeneous evidence regimes
hidden world state could become free machine information
unregistered intervention class made minimality ambiguous
architecture identity omitted starting capital/development protocol
generality was incorrectly described as a partial order on machine identities rather than a preorder
blockers: independent hostile review of the corrected core
check continuous/stochastic measure-theoretic wording and approximate equivalence semantics

synthesis_theory.question: Do major parent theories embed as special cases/modules without changing GMI definitions?
blockers: verify each load-bearing reduction against precise primary-source theorem assumptions
write formal bridge details for stochastic predictive-state/bisimulation special cases
record any parent pair whose assumptions cannot be jointly composed

synthesis_theory.question: Do materially different machine-intelligence forms instantiate the same morphology/state/resource schema?
blockers: run schema validator/tests in repository environment
family-scale executable exemplars for at least four families
bounded compiler/resource receipts rather than prose mappings only

synthesis_theory.question: Are core profile/dominance/amortization/developmental-capital definitions executable and exact on reference cases?
bugs_closed: strict dominance incorrectly survived a loss on another ecology
rank-information median fixture expected the wrong exact value
blockers: execute reference and specialization tests in repository CI/checkout
add censored/failure and multi-capability hostile fixtures
bind exact developmental quotient/scaling receipts into one F3 suite

new_general_law.question: Can pre-outcome structure predict later developmental burden within a nontrivial family on held-out tasks?
Does one compact predictor/invariant transfer across materially different morphology families beyond their native parent predictors?
Can a prospectively derived morphology/frontier phase transition be recovered endogenously from a neutral candidate space?

new_morphology.question: Can a theory-predicted parent-frontier hole be filled by a non-parent-equivalent morphology?
new_morphology.unlock: prospective obstruction/headroom region against strongest known/hybrid parents

recursive_improvement.question: Does the burden to discover verified frontier improvements decline across genuine fresh generations under a fixed constitution?

important_boundary: Failure of E1/E2/E5 does not automatically invalidate the synthesis theory; it means the synthesis may remain a metrology/formal integration framework rather than a new cross-paradigm law.
